jobs.name: Native Ren'Py save and screen checks

checks: Android Keystore private text is encrypted outside backup; worker JNI uses the app loader and callbacks run on the engine owner
Native haptic requests run on Android's UI thread and return a boolean without claiming physical vibration
A real native custom-field form saves into its own private collection without changing ordinary Records
Android native audio playback advances, video visibly decodes both colors and ATL moves; stop/restart and menu exit control playback
A native InputConnection composes and commits café into the actual form; cancelling preserves saved Records and the waiting story
Android app switching preserves the live Records draft, waiting story and reading settings without saving a record
Real Android text choosers receive Unicode/multiline history and saved Records on the UI thread; dismissal preserves the draft, story, preferences and saves
Native history/record copy and Unicode/multiline paste use the platform clipboard; rejected title paste preserves the draft
Scoped document export/import, cancellation, malformed JSON and confirmed backup merge preserve the draft; another UID reads the granted attachment offline
Real Android edit/cancel/save and cancelled/confirmed record deletion retain the intended saved data
Authenticated private storage rejects tampered ciphertext without deleting it or replacing the key
Android taps move through Home/history/settings/Records and return to the exact dialogue
Force-stop/relaunch and durable Resume preserve story position, private Records and reading preferences
A background process kill recovers the waiting choice; switching apps from cold Home keeps that latest checkpoint
Native background recovery restores dialogue and choices newer than the explicit saves while keeping Records and reading settings
Loading an older Android quick save restores the earlier dialogue/choice state while keeping newer Records and reading preferences
Native save-name input, create/confirmed overwrite, process restart and confirmed named-load restore the chosen dialogue
Replay resets story/history/choice state while preserving Records, reading settings, quick and named checkpoints
Cancelling deletion retains the checkpoint; confirming deletes only the named checkpoint
A signed same-key APK upgrade starts the new version while keeping Records, preferences, quick saves, story Resume and the encrypted Keystore entry
Private storage survives process restart, older quick-load and replay; explicit deletion removes the entry and subsequent reads return missing
Compact and tall emulator sizes/densities retain the live draft, saved data and reading settings with tappable inputs; a landscape request respects the portrait app
Implicit warm Record links, deliberate repeated delivery and Copy link keep the same interpreter, unsaved draft, waiting story, Records and preferences; closing keeps input inactive
Malformed, foreign-package, file, label, query/fragment and non-VIEW links cannot act on story or application data; unavailable Records show a closable preview without replacing drafts
A real tap in another UID's offline app sends a VIEW Intent with no task flags; the single-task SDL activity reuses the same interpreter, draft and waiting story
A cold implicit Record link resolves the package-specific filter and previews current saved data over Home; only an explicit Resume restores the waiting story with current Records and settings
Implicit link launch after background process death preserves the pending recovery bytes; explicit Resume restores the waiting dialogue and consumed Intents never reopen after menu navigation

values.title: Emulator note
values.body:
Someone left a folded note at the lighthouse: ‘Meet at Blåbær Cove before sunset.’
The tide is coming in.

limitations: Custom URI scheme only; verified HTTPS App Links and browser associations are not implemented
Links preview the default Records collection and DEFAULT_FIELDS; custom routes/schemas are not implemented
ADB Intents and a real tap from another UID with no task flags were exercised; browser-specific behavior and physical ARM devices remain unverified
The disabled clean AAB manifest is checked; a disabled-project installation is not exercised
Hardware-backed Keystore, audible playback, felt haptics and additional IMEs require physical-device coverage
Board touch and optional richer controls remain unverified
Disposable signing keys and validation artifacts are not production signing or an application release
